data.narrative:
HyImpulse is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised €74 million to date. The valuation analysis relies on a peer-median approach across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B, Series C), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C).

The peer-median method yields an implied valuation of $1.5B, with the five-company set ranging from $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (median 23.9x across six listed Space & Aerospace companies including RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, and SATL) is not applicable because the target's revenue is not disclosed. This is typical for private companies at this stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.3B (low) to $1.7B (high), centered on $1.5B. This range rests on a single applicable method, creating meaningful uncertainty. Key risks to this valuation include concentration risk in the peer set, stage variation within the comparables (two Series C vs. two Series B), and the wide dispersion across peers ($1.1B–$8.0B). Validation would benefit from revenue-based metrics or transaction multiples for private raises in the same cohort.
